ui.dashboard.title: Dashboard
ui.dashboard.quota_gifts_only: YouTube quota is almost used up. Until it resets (midnight Pacific time), only gifts and follows go to YouTube.
ui.add_placeholder: Type a word and press Enter
ui.settings.title: Settings
ui.settings.applies_next_start: Changes are saved right away and are used the next time you press Start.
ui.settings.save_failed: Your change could not be saved: %1
ui.settings.username_hint: The LIVE to read. Type it without the @.
ui.settings.youtube_quota_hint: YouTube allows about 500 messages a day, so follows, likes, shares and reposts start off.
ui.settings.compact: Compact mode: join chat lines into one message
ui.settings.live_hours: How long your LIVE usually lasts (hours)
ui.settings.live_hours_hint: Between 0.5 and 12 hours. StreamBridge spreads YouTube messages so the daily quota lasts this long. Applies from the next Start.
ui.settings.spam_hint: Messages containing these are not relayed.
ui.settings.rude_hint: Added to the built-in list. They are shown as a****g.
ui.settings.allowed_hint: Words from the built-in list that you want to allow.
ui.settings.euler_hint: Only needed if the free limit is used up. It is stored in Windows Credential Manager.
ui.settings.euler_saved: A key is saved. Type a new one to replace it.
ui.about.title: About
ui.about.tagline: Your TikTok viewers, visible on Twitch and YouTube.
ui.settings.setup_hint: Go through the first-run steps again, for example to change where messages go.
ui.wizard.welcome.title: Welcome to StreamBridge
ui.wizard.welcome.body: Show your TikTok LIVE viewers in your Twitch and YouTube chat. Setup takes about two minutes and needs no technical knowledge.
ui.wizard.tiktok.title: Which TikTok LIVE do you want to read?
ui.wizard.tiktok.body: Type the username of the account that goes LIVE. You do not need to log in to TikTok.
ui.wizard.destinations.title: Where should the messages go?
ui.wizard.destinations.body: Pick at least one. You can change this later in Settings.
ui.wizard.destinations.need_one: Pick at least one to continue.
ui.wizard.twitch.title: Connect Twitch
ui.wizard.youtube.title: Connect YouTube
ui.wizard.login_later: Logging in is not available in this version yet. It arrives in a later update. Your choice is saved, so you can continue.
ui.wizard.done.title: The setup is finished
ui.wizard.done.note: Messages will reach Twitch and YouTube once logging in is available. You can change everything in Settings.
